value.rationale: The number of distinct unbordered factors is a natural combinatorics-on-words invariant (important for border-free matching), distinct from total factor or permutation complexity. This establishes a complete infinite family of natural lengths for every Cantor-like automatic word, a closed list of factors, and the exact parameter-dependent growth exponent log_q(2). Neither a small arbitrary finite slice nor a routine rephrasing of prior complexity tables.
